nl: 商城订单管理：查询有订单号；表格展示订单号、订单金额、会员等级、免邮说明；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「免邮说明」在订单金额不低于 99 元，或会员等级为 VIP 时隐藏。
nlEn: Online-store order management: query by order number; the table shows order number, order amount, member level and free-shipping note; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "free-shipping note" is hidden when the order amount is at least 99, or the member level is VIP.
notes: AI-16: 表达式 isHidden（跨字段 or + 序关系 >=）—— 满 99 元或 VIP 会员时隐藏免邮说明（vue2/schema）
